metrics.name: Active Company Count
metrics.gotcha: Companies[].disabled is BOOLEAN (false = active, true = disabled). Use backtick-quoted boolean literal.

metrics.name: Total Company Count
metrics.gotcha: Companies[] is the customer/contact roster. Fields include: id, business_name, firstname, lastname, email, phone, disabled (boolean), location_name, contacts, DaysSinceCreated_r (Liongard-computed integer).

metrics.name: Total Contract Count
metrics.gotcha: Contracts[].status is LOWERCASE string (e.g. 'Opportunity', 'Active'). Fields include: id, name, description, customer_id, contract_amount, start_date, end_date, status, sla_id, DaysUntilExpiration_r, DaysSinceCreated_r.

metrics.name: Admin Technician Count
metrics.gotcha: The field name is literally 'admin?' (with a question mark). JMESPath requires double-quoting special-character field names: Users[?"admin?" == `true`]. The field is BOOLEAN.

metrics.name: Total Technician User Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[] contains technician accounts (not customer contacts). Fields include: id, email, full_name, group, admin? (boolean — JMESPath requires double-quoting), color, DaysSinceCreated_r.
